# Cat, phase 2: chamfers that make it faceted, materials (Cyclope6 colours, exact), flat shading,
# the export of the gated hero. Run after p1_blockout.txt. Generated by make_cat.py.
material new Fur --base-color 0.388 0.106 0.204 --no-slot
material new Slate --base-color 0.196 0.325 0.373 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.188 0.882 0.725 --emission 0.188 0.882 0.725 --no-slot
select Torso
active Torso
mode edit
select all
bevel 0.07 --segments 1
mode object
select Head
active Head
mode edit
select all
bevel 0.06 --segments 1
mode object
select TailA
active TailA
mode edit
select all
bevel 0.025 --segments 1
mode object
select TailB
active TailB
mode edit
select all
bevel 0.025 --segments 1
mode object
select TailC
active TailC
mode edit
select all
bevel 0.025 --segments 1
mode object
select Torso
active Torso
mode edit
select vert where "pos.y < -0.1 && pos.z < 0.36"
translate 0 0.05 0
mode object
select Torso Head EarL EarR TailA TailB TailC Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3
material assign Fur
select Muzzle Paw0 Paw1 Paw2 Paw3
material assign Slate
select EyeL EyeR
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export cat.glb
